text: D208945 review asked the new helper functions in ExtensionAccounts.sys.mjs to have block comments, especially the exported getWildcardVirtualFolders because another module consumes its result. The landed comment explains that * virtual folders search eligible folders and declares @param {VirtualFolderWrapper} and @returns {nsIMsgFolder[]}. D208762 likewise changed smart-folder helpers to @returns {?nsIMsgFolder} when null is possible. For new cross-module helpers, describe the behavior and use an exact result type, including nullability. This is a reviewed documentation syntax rule beyond formatting.
title: Document exported cross-module helpers with block comments and return types
